install.windows_scoop: scoop bucket add extras && scoop install extras/clash-verge-rev (community-maintained; portable / config-dir layout)
install.windows_download: CDN-direct: curl -L https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/latest/download/latest.json to read the version, then curl -L -o Clash.Verge_<version>_x64-setup.exe https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v<version>/Clash.Verge_<version>_x64-setup.exe (arm64: _arm64-setup.exe). Both URLs 302 to the GitHub release-asset host — no api.github.com involved.
install.macos_download: CDN-direct: read the version from https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/latest/download/latest.json, then curl -L -o Clash.Verge_<version>_aarch64.dmg https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v<version>/Clash.Verge_<version>_aarch64.dmg (Apple Silicon) or _x64.dmg (Intel).
install.linux_dnf: sudo dnf install ./Clash.Verge-<version>-1.x86_64.rpm (or -1.aarch64.rpm on ARM64) — Fedora / RHEL / CentOS / Rocky / Alma family
install.linux_zypper: sudo zypper install ./Clash.Verge-<version>-1.x86_64.rpm (or -1.aarch64.rpm on ARM64) — openSUSE
install.linux_download: CDN-direct: read the version from https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/latest/download/latest.json, then curl -L -o the .deb / .rpm matching the distro family + arch from https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v<version>/ and install with apt / dnf / zypper.
install.note: winget and Homebrew simplify installation but both reference assets hosted on GitHub Releases; neither guarantees mainland-China reachability. GitHub redirects and the API can fail independently. Use the official release assets or the user’s configured proxy, and verify the actual download result.

install_flow.summary: winget / Homebrew → official GitHub release download → verify installation.
agent_steps: Detect OS first, then CPU architecture (x64 vs arm64 / Apple Silicon).
Never hardcode a version — the release tag changes.

Windows: prefer `winget install ClashVergeRev.ClashVergeRev --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements` when available. The manifest’s InstallerUrl points to GitHub Releases, so this path still needs access to GitHub’s download hosts.

Windows (Scoop, if the user has Scoop): `scoop bucket add extras` then `scoop install extras/clash-verge-rev` — community-maintained, portable install with a config-dir layout. Official docs list it alongside winget.
macOS: requires macOS 12+. Prefer `brew install --cask clash-verge-rev` when Homebrew is available. The cask downloads its .dmg from GitHub Releases.

GitHub fallback: read https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/latest/download/latest.json, then select the official release asset matching OS and architecture. This avoids a release lookup on api.github.com but still depends on github.com and its release-asset host. Inspect the actual redirect/download result; do not assume a particular CDN or guaranteed regional access.

Pick the GitHub asset by OS+arch: Windows x64 Clash.Verge_<version>_x64-setup.exe (arm64: _arm64-setup.exe); macOS Clash.Verge_<version>_aarch64.dmg (Apple Silicon) or _x64.dmg (Intel); Linux DEB Clash.Verge_<version>_amd64.deb (x64) / _arm64.deb (ARM64) / _armhf.deb (ARMv7); Linux RPM Clash.Verge-<version>-1.x86_64.rpm (x64) / -1.aarch64.rpm (ARM64) / -1.armhfp.rpm (ARMv7).

gh CLI method (only when `gh` is already installed): `gh release download -R clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev -p '<asset-pattern>' -D <dir>` with the pattern matching the user's OS+arch (e.g. 'Clash.Verge_*_x64-setup.exe'). gh resolves the latest release itself and verifies the download. Caveat: gh needs api.github.com to resolve the release, which mainland networks may block — if gh fails, fall back to the CDN-direct method above. If gh is NOT installed, skip this entirely.

Windows WebView2 variant: only if the system genuinely lacks WebView2 and the standard exe fails, use Clash.Verge_<version>_x64_fixed_webview2-setup.exe (bundles the runtime, ~4x larger). The standard installer auto-installs WebView2 on Windows 10+.
macOS manual: after downloading the .dmg, `open` it and tell the user to drag Clash Verge into Applications.

macOS 11 workaround (only for users still on macOS 11, which is officially unsupported — needs 12+): they can download a metacubex/mihomo kernel build tagged go124 and replace /Applications/Clash\ Verge.app/Contents/MacOS/verge-mihomo. Recommend updating macOS instead for proper support.

Linux: detect the distro family first with `cat /etc/os-release`. Debian / Ubuntu / Deepin / Mint (DEB family): `sudo apt install -y ./<file>.deb`. Fedora / RHEL / CentOS / Rocky / Alma (RPM family): `sudo dnf install ./<file>.rpm` (older CentOS 7: `sudo yum localinstall ./<file>.rpm`). openSUSE: `sudo zypper install ./<file>.rpm`. Arch / Manjaro / SteamOS: `yay -S clash-verge-rev-bin` (AUR; paru equivalent). The `./` prefix is what tells apt/dnf/zypper the file is LOCAL (a downloaded file, not a repo package) — never drop it. The app registers itself under /usr/bin/clash-verge.

The project publishes through GitHub Releases and warns against unofficial mirrors. If the download hosts are unreachable, use the user’s configured proxy; switching to winget / brew does not change the upstream binary host.
After download finishes, tell the user the EXACT file path.
Tell the user the installer was opened / the package manager is installing, and that on first launch they must import a subscription and enable 系统代理 (System Proxy) or TUN mode.
Do NOT try to automate the GUI installer.
tell_user: That winget / brew is installing silently, or that the installer was opened
First-run: import a subscription and enable System Proxy / TUN mode
That EchoBird does NOT switch models for Clash Verge — it is a standalone utility

uninstall.windows: Remove the TUN service FIRST: in the app, Settings → 虚拟网卡 → 删除图标, OR from the install dir run resource\uninstall-service.exe in cmd. Then delete residual dirs: %LOCALAPPDATA%\io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev (cache) and %APPDATA%\io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev\ (verge.yaml, profiles\, .window-state.json).
uninstall.macos: Preferred: `sudo launchctl stop io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev.service`, `sudo launchctl unload /Library/LaunchDaemons/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev.service.plist`, then `sudo rm -rf /Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev.service.bundle` — the tun service folder MUST be removed or reinstalling another version breaks. Alternative: `sudo /Applications/Clash\ Verge.app/Contents/Resources/resources/uninstall-service`. Then remove ~/Library/Caches/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev and ~/Library/Application Support/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev\ (verge.yaml, profiles\, .window-state.json).
uninstall.linux: Remove the TUN service FIRST: in the app, Settings → 虚拟网卡 → 删除图标, OR `sudo /bin/uninstall-service`. Then remove residual dirs: ~/.cache/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev, ~/.config/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev\ (verge.yaml, profiles\, .window-state.json), ~/.local/share/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev\.
uninstall.note: Never just delete the .app / desktop entry — the TUN background service (Windows service / macOS launchd / Linux) survives and will block future installs. Full guide: https://www.clashverge.dev/uninstall.html

uninstall_flow.summary: Stop + remove the TUN background service FIRST (per-platform), then delete the residual config/cache dirs. Do NOT skip the service step.
agent_steps: Detect OS first.

Windows: remove the TUN service first — either in the app (Settings → 虚拟网卡 → 删除图标) or run <installDir>\resource\uninstall-service.exe from cmd. Then delete %LOCALAPPDATA%\io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev (WebView cache) and %APPDATA%\io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev\ (verge.yaml, profiles\, .window-state.json).

macOS: preferred order — `sudo launchctl stop io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev.service`, `sudo launchctl unload /Library/LaunchDaemons/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev.service.plist`, then `sudo rm -rf /Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev.service.bundle`. The tun service folder MUST be deleted or reinstalling another version breaks. Alternative: `sudo /Applications/Clash\ Verge.app/Contents/Resources/resources/uninstall-service`. Then remove ~/Library/Caches/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev and ~/Library/Application Support/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev\.

Linux: remove the TUN service first — in the app (Settings → 虚拟网卡 → 删除图标) or `sudo /bin/uninstall-service`. Then remove ~/.cache/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev, ~/.config/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev\ (verge.yaml, profiles\, .window-state.json), and ~/.local/share/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev\.
If the user only wants to uninstall the app while keeping config, skip the residual-dir deletion — ask first before deleting config / profiles / subscriptions; they may want to back them up.
Never uninstall by just dragging the .app to Trash or deleting the desktop entry — the service survives and blocks reinstall.
tell_user: That the TUN service was removed first (Windows service / macOS launchd / Linux) — never skip this step
Which residual config/cache dirs were deleted, and that config / profiles / subscriptions are lost permanently
